snippet.title: Solarpunk - Release Date Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Solarpunk: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1805110 

Solarpunk is a calm survival game in a technically advanced world of floating islands. Alone or together with your friends, you can construct buildings, grow food, craft gadgets and explore distant islands with your own airship. Use sunlight and wind to create an energy system and automate your processes like gathering resources and watering your plants to build your dream home in the sky. Developed by just two people the game reached 1mio Wishlist on Steam. After more than four years of development, Solarpunk has finally revealed its release date: June 8, 2026 for PC (Steam, Epic, GoG), Xbox S/X, PS5 & Switch 2.

Follow news and updates on The Triple-i Initiative:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/triple-i-initiative-2026 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/iii-initiative.bsky.social 
Bilibili: https://space.bilibili.com/3546638813497663 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iii_initiative/
Twitter: https://x.com/iii_initiative 

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more over on https://iii-initiative.com
